title: Software Engineering Internship
description: Join our engineering team and work on cutting-edge full-stack applications. You will collaborate with experienced engineers on real-world projects while learning industry best practices.
requirements: Currently enrolled in BSc Computer Science, BSc Information Technology, or related field. Knowledge of JavaScript, React, and Node.js is beneficial. Strong communication skills and passion for learning.

title: Graduate Data Science Program
description: Fast-track your data science career with our intensive graduate program. Work on real datasets, learn machine learning, and join a network of top data professionals.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field. Knowledge of Python and SQL. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Frontend Development Internship
description: Work with our creative team building responsive user interfaces. Collaborate with designers and backend developers to deliver engaging web experiences.
requirements: Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Experience with React or Vue.js. Attention to detail and understanding of UX principles.

title: Business Analyst Graduate Program
description: Structured program for commerce graduates entering the business consulting space. Mentorship from senior analysts and exposure to diverse industry challenges.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, or related field. Excellent written and verbal communication. Analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

title: Mobile App Development Internship
description: Build native and cross-platform mobile applications. Learn best practices in app development, testing, and deployment. Work with modern frameworks and tools.
requirements: Knowledge of Swift, Kotlin, React Native, or Flutter. Familiarity with mobile development principles. Keen to learn and collaborate with the team.

title: Financial Services Graduate Program
description: Comprehensive program for commerce graduates looking to build careers in financial services. Training in financial analysis, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or Economics. Strong numerical skills. Interest in financial markets and investment.

title: Network Engineering Internship
description: Work with enterprise network infrastructure. Gain hands-on experience with routers, switches, and network security. Mentor-led learning environment with real production systems.
requirements: Currently studying IT or Computer Science. Understanding of networking basics and TCP/IP. Interest in cybersecurity is a bonus.

title: Marketing Graduate Scheme
description: Launch your marketing career with exposure to digital, content, and brand strategy. Work on campaigns for major brands, learn analytics, and build a professional network.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Commerce, or Communications. Creative thinking and digital marketing knowledge. Experience with analytics tools beneficial.

title: UX/UI Design Internship
description: Create digital experiences for mobile and web applications. Work with Figma, user research, and design systems. Collaborate with product and engineering teams.
requirements: Portfolio of design work required. Proficiency in design tools like Figma or Adobe XD. Understanding of user-centered design principles.

title: Supply Chain Graduate Program
description: Structured program covering procurement, logistics, and supply chain optimization. Real-world projects with multinational companies. Leadership development included.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Commerce, or Engineering. Analytical skills and attention to detail. Interest in operations and process improvement.

title: QA Testing Internship
description: Learn software testing methodologies. Test web and mobile applications. Work with automation frameworks and bug tracking systems. Development team collaboration.
requirements: Studying IT or Computer Science. Attention to detail and logical thinking. Knowledge of basic programming or scripting helpful.

title: Environmental Engineering Internship
description: Work on sustainability projects and environmental impact assessments. Gain experience with water treatment, waste management, and renewable energy systems.
requirements: Enrolled in Environmental, Civil, or Chemical Engineering. Technical drawing and CAD experience. Strong environmental awareness.

title: Accounting Graduate Program
description: Fast-track your journey to chartered accountant status. Audit, tax, and consulting exposure. CPA/ACCA exam support. Continuous professional development.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. Excellent numerical and analytical skills. Interest in audit and assurance.

title: Content Writer Internship
description: Create engaging content for blogs, social media, and marketing campaigns. Work with editors and marketing teams. Build your portfolio with published pieces.
requirements: Strong writing skills and attention to grammar. Interest in digital marketing and SEO. Portfolio or writing samples required.

title: Human Resources Graduate Program
description: Build HR expertise through recruitment, training, employee relations, and organizational development. Exposure to multiple industries and company sizes.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in HR, Psychology, Commerce, or related field. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Interest in employee development.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Internship
description: Work with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud platforms. Deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure. Learn DevOps practices and containerization with experienced engineers.
requirements: Studying Computer Science or IT. Linux command line knowledge. Understanding of cloud concepts and networking.

title: Structural Engineering Internship
description: Gain experience in structural design and analysis. Work on residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects. Use industry software like SAP2000 and Revit.
requirements: Enrolled in Civil or Structural Engineering. Technical drawing skills. Knowledge of building codes and safety standards.

title: Management Consulting Graduate Program
description: Solve complex business problems for leading companies. Learn strategic thinking, data analysis, and client management. Mentorship from experienced consultants.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in any field with strong analytical skills. Leadership potential and professional demeanor. Willingness to travel locally.

title: Pharmaceutical Sales Internship
description: Build sales and market knowledge in the pharmaceutical industry. Work with healthcare professionals and distribution networks. Develop business development skills.
requirements: Studying Commerce, Science, or Health-related fields. Strong communication and persuasion skills. Valid driver's license beneficial.
